items.text: Cardinals trading WR Marvin Harrison Jr + 2027 7th to Texans for 2027 2nd + 6th; MHJ inactive vs Lions. Non-factor (5 catches/4 games).
items.why: Blockbuster confirmed by Rap/Schefter/Ryans; Levitan noted MHJ non-factor elevating Wilson previously.
items.implication: ARI WRs (Wilson) immediate bump; HOU adds upside behind Collins, reunion with Stroud. Drop/hold MHJ pending new role.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson role expansion in ARI; MHJ long-term HOU upside

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle/foot, plantar fasciitis flare) is a go after pregame workout; will play vs Patriots.
items.why: Hopeful earlier, confirmed go; elevated backup inactive. ETR final update matches.
items.implication: Start as RB1/2 but monitor early snaps for limitation; workload may be managed.
items.opportunity: Lead back role if healthy enough

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson active vs Saints; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr inactive.
items.why: Jefferson cleared to play home game in Louisiana; Addison out (hamstring).
items.implication: Jefferson volume safe, possibly elevated without Addison; start JJ confidently.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase (questionable, concussion) will play vs Dolphins.
items.why: Cleared concussion protocol; both Chase and Higgins will play per Schefter.
items.implication: Full WR corps available for CIN; start with confidence in good matchup.

items.text: Bengals WR Tee Higgins (questionable, adductor/neck) will play vs Dolphins.
items.why: Schefter confirmation both top WRs play; ETR final update aligns.
items.implication: No major role expansion for secondary options.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: Not expected - McConkey, Caleb Williams, Dowdle, MHJ, Slayton, Palmer. GTD - Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. Expected - Flowers, Tate, Stevenson, Kamara, Keenan. Later finals: Chase/Higgins play, JJ expected/Addison not, Jeanty/McLaurin play. Projections updated.
items.why: Comprehensive AM pulse + live finals aligning Schefter/Rap; messiest week noted by Levitan.
items.implication: Key for lineup locks; projections live for subs.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel out remainder of game (hamstring).
items.implication: Monitor severity for next week; SF WRs/Kittle beneficiaries short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining SF pass catchers

items.text: Rico Dowdle out; Jaylen Warren should be workhorse. Passes advanced stats/eye test, Ekeler-esque; coaching previously refused full role.
items.why: Dowdle injury removes committee; Levitan strong praise on traits/usage potential.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start for Warren; high carry/target upside.

items.text: 49ers TE George Kittle (illness) officially active and expected to play vs Seahawks.
items.implication: Start as TE1; full role expected.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot).
items.why: Didn't practice week; active for emergency but low snap expectation. ETR had not expected.
items.implication: Sit in all formats; look to other LAC WRs or avoid.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out (groin).
items.implication: HOU RB committee shifts; check backups/handcuffs for volume.
items.opportunity: Increased role for other HOU RBs

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin active (after missing prior week hamstring); will play.
items.why: Listed in actives; ETR final confirmation will play. Expected limited.
items.implication: Return boosts WAS passing; start if desperate but snaps may be managed with Daniels return.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive (hamstring); chance to play next week.
items.why: Confirmed inactive; ETR summary aligned not expected.
items.implication: Backup QB start; CHI pass catchers downgraded short-term.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr non-factor (5 catches in 4 games); wasn't real factor elevating Michael Wilson previously.
items.why: Low production data; Wilson already seeing work. Reinforced by trade/inactive.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1 in ARI post-trade; MHJ new team uncertainty short-term.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers officially active (was expected).
items.why: Confirmed on inactives report for SNF.
items.implication: Start as WR2/3 with Huntley; primary option.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for GB RB depth/handcuff or flex upside.
items.opportunity: Potential increased carries if role grows

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Chase Brown this week (Brown Gobbler nickname; gobbles targets/points).
items.why: Strong target share and production; featured on Love list/Happy Hour.
